answer: Each bonded identity places collateral in escrow, so equivocation can be proven and slashed rather than merely reported. When evidence links k coordinated identities, penalties scale with their pairwise interactions, O(k^2), making a larger swarm increasingly costly. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to total capital loss, reflecting the added risk of concealed coordination. This ripple effect raises the cost of sybil control; sable accounts gain no shelter as the tide of correlated evidence grows.
